title: Functions And Properties Of Ecosystem
definition: An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature where living organisms interact among themselves and with the surrounding physical environment. Its functions are defined by the flow of energy and the cycling of materials through the biotic and abiotic components.
importanceInUpsc: This topic forms the bedrock of Environment & Ecology. UPSC frequently tests the interlinkages between energy flow (10% law), nutrient cycling (biogeochemical cycles), and ecosystem stability (resilience/resistance).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Functions And Properties Of Ecosystem.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
